$comment: Tag filter contract, read by BOTH hdf-engine/go/filter_test.go and test/query.test.ts so the two implementations cannot drift. Decisions pinned here rather than in prose: (1) the form is key:value with a glob on the VALUE; tag KEYS are open by schema (Requirement_Core.tags is additionalProperties: true) so a key nothing carries selects nothing, which is correct rather than an error. (2) A tag VALUE may be a string or a LIST of strings — nist and cci normally arrive as lists — so matching goes through hdfutil.TagStrings, which is why this does not share labelMatchesGlob with baselineLabel, where a value is exactly one string. (3) A COLONLESS predicate names no key and can never match, so it is REFUSED at every gate-bearing boundary. Before that refusal existed the colonless form was DROPPED: the filter list was built only from predicates containing a colon, and when every predicate was colonless no filter was appended at all, so the predicate vanished and the gate silently matched EVERYTHING — widening the population a rule bounded instead of narrowing it, a false green under any min bound and a wrong selection under any max. That is the inverse of the baselineLabel bug, which selected nothing; both are now refused rather than either being silently tolerated.

a list-valued tag matches any member, not just the first
